qs.s: Mon salaire ___ est versé le premier du mois.

qs.en: She receives a monthly allowance to cover her transport costs.

qs.en: The monthly charges for this apartment are very high.

qs.en: Stop saying stupid things, nobody believes you.

qs.en: He said another stupid thing in front of everyone.

qs.en: This report is full of crap, there's no point reading it.

qs.en: He's been talking for an hour and everything he says is rubbish.

qs.s: Quitter ce travail sans avoir un autre poste, c'était vraiment une ___ .
qs.en: Leaving that job without having another position lined up was really a stupid move.

qs.s: Les jeunes font parfois des ___ qu'ils regrettent ensuite.
qs.en: Young people sometimes do stupid things that they later regret.

qs.en: That decision is a real piece of stupidity.

qs.en: The Battle of Verdun was one of the bloodiest conflicts of the First World War.

qs.en: History remembers this massacre as one of the cruelest acts of the regime.

qs.s: Le soldat est revenu du champ de bataille avec un uniforme ___.
qs.en: The soldier came back from the battlefield with a uniform covered in blood.

qs.en: She found a knife covered in blood on the table and called the police.

qs.s: Les historiens qualifient ces deux conflits de particulièrement ___.
qs.en: Historians describe these two conflicts as particularly bloody.

qs.en: The civil war was marked by unprecedented bloody repression.

qs.en: The authorities finally put an end to these bloody acts of violence that had been going on for weeks.

qs.en: The bloody images broadcast by the media sparked international outrage.
